retained_profile.description: clean post-P4.1 short decode profile; stable steps exclude the first two transitions
retained_profile.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-laguna-iq2.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-p4-current-short-profile --output-file epyc -- .venv/bin/python -u /tmp/laguna_p2_split_decode_profile_child.py /models/gguf/Laguna-S-2.1-UD-Q2_K_XL.gguf --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --prompt-id code_merge_intervals --backend hip_gfx1100 --context-length 4096 --chunk-size 128 --decode-tokens 16 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-laguna-iq2.txt --global-split-min-live 127 --swa-split-min-live 65 --output /tmp/laguna-p4-current-short-profile/bench.json

matched_budget.conclusion: submission-only work cannot beat Vulkan unless accompanied by further exact device-work reduction

candidate.description: one native HSA AQL queue; prefill 820 dependent kernel-dispatch packets; ring one doorbell; wait only on the final completion signal
candidate.dependency_contract: barrier bit on every dispatch, agent-scope acquire/release per dependent kernel, system-scope release on the final packet
candidate.body: one-workgroup dependent uint32 increment; identical HIP and AQL source body; final value must equal 820
candidate.aql_timing_scope: doorbell store through final signal only; packet construction is deliberately excluded, favoring AQL
candidate.hip_timing_scope: all 820 hipLaunchKernel host calls plus final hipDeviceSynchronize
candidate.reason_runtime_integration_skipped: the mechanism fails its generous isolated 820-dispatch precondition in every process

prior_mechanisms.D8_capture_replay: already rejected and removed; steady graph replay regressed unprofiled wall
prior_mechanisms.D16_host_packets: already rejected; preserved dispatches and did not remove queue spacing
prior_mechanisms.new_evidence: direct AQL packet ownership with one doorbell and packet-build time excluded

decision.reason: correct dependency fences make direct AQL 0.560-0.758% slower than HIP across five independent 820-dispatch processes even when packet construction is free; it cannot remove the measured 3.213-ms span-minus-kernel window
decision.next: reduce exact device work and dispatch count through independently winning fused bodies; do not restore D8, D16, or this direct-AQL owner
